meta.concept: allok · De problema a sistema — brand concept packaged 29 Oct 2026 (outputs/allok-brand: DIRECTION.md, brand.css, assets/tokens.css, SVG masters)
meta.note: The four brand colours, the derived neutrals, the type scale, spacing and the motion curve are the concept's own values (assets/tokens.css and brand.css). Added for a working system: the three themes (cloud, ink, blue) as semantic tokens, ground-2 on ink, text-muted-2, radius-control and radius-window, and the size family. Geist is the full Variable 1.800 from the geist npm package 1.7.2 — the same version the concept subset, with the arrows it lacked.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Brand. The work, the text, the precision. The text colour on Cloud (18.3:1), the closing field of every page, the mark on Cloud. Constant in every theme.

tokens.name: cloud
tokens.usage: Brand. The space where the system breathes. The page ground, and the white of the white logo masters (they are drawn in Cloud, not #fff). Never cream, never warm.

tokens.name: blue
tokens.usage: Brand. Electric Blue: the brand in motion, never a state. A field (one blue section per page: the latest build), the primary action, the outcome word of a statement, the focus ring. Text in blue only on `cloud` (4.8:1); on `ink` only at 24px+ (3.8:1). Never a status, never a gradient, never cyan or purple.

tokens.name: steel
tokens.usage: Brand. Context, support and calm. Secondary text on `cloud` (4.6:1) and the swatch. On `ground-2` it drops to 4.2:1 — use `steel-deep`. Never on blue (1.04:1: the same lightness).

tokens.name: steel-deep
tokens.usage: Steel one step darker, for secondary text and labels on `ground-2` in the Cloud theme (5.4:1). From the concept's palette band.

tokens.name: ground
tokens.usage: The section's field. Cloud for most of a page, Blue once (the latest build), Ink to close. Set the theme on the section, never paint a ground by hand.

tokens.name: ground-2
tokens.usage: One step off the field: a showcase's stage, a tile, the command list. Blue has no second ground (same value) — on blue, separate with `line` or nest a Cloud surface. Ink's #16191b is derived, one step above ink.

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Headlines, body and controls on `ground` and `ground-2` (Cloud 18.3:1 · Ink 18.3:1 · Blue 5.1:1). On blue every word is this white: hierarchy comes from size and weight.

tokens.name: text-muted
tokens.usage: Leads, captions, labels, the second line — on `ground` only (Cloud 4.6:1 · Ink 7.9:1). On blue there is no muted text: it stays white.

tokens.name: text-muted-2
tokens.usage: The same role on `ground-2` (Cloud 5.4:1 · Ink 7.1:1).

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines that separate: section borders, row separators, the header's bottom edge. Decorative, never the only edge of a control.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: The 1px rule that opens a list and the underline of a link-button and of the command field — the edge that says 'this acts'.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: The outcome: the second line of a statement ('OK.'), the primary button's fill, a build's name on a post card. Blue on Cloud and Ink, Ink on Blue. On Ink and Blue it is 3.8:1 — 24px+ text and fills only.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: The label of a button filled with `accent` (5.1:1 on blue, 19.5:1 on ink).

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: The 2px focus ring, 4px offset, on everything that can be focused (Cloud 4.8:1 · Ink 3.8:1 · Blue 5.1:1).

tokens.name: demo
tokens.usage: Text of the demo label — 'Demo · not live data' — on `demo-ground` (5.9:1). The only colour outside the four, and it means one thing: this is not live.

tokens.name: demo-ground
tokens.usage: Ground of the demo label, in any theme.

styles.name: statement
styles.usage: The one sentence of a page, two lines, the outcome line in `accent`. `clamp(4rem, 11vw, 13rem)`; this is the ceiling.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: A phrase of three words or fewer that owns a section. `clamp(3.5rem, 8vw, 9rem)`.

styles.name: headline
styles.usage: A section title (h2), broken by hand into two short lines. `clamp(2.5rem, 5.4vw, 6.5rem)`.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: A build's name in its showcase, on its page and on its post card. `clamp(2.3rem, 4vw, 4.5rem)`.

styles.name: subhead
styles.sample: Name what you feel. Say it out loud.
styles.usage: A sentence that is a whole row: a build's line on its own page, a principle pulled out. `clamp(1.3rem, 2.3vw, 2.5rem)`.

styles.name: heading
styles.usage: A name inside a list: log rows and command results.

styles.name: lead
styles.sample: I'm Adrián. I build AI systems that take the busywork off your business.
styles.usage: The paragraph under a statement or a headline, in `text-muted`, ≤ 470px wide. `clamp(1.15rem, 1.8vw, 1.65rem)`.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Every build ships with its code. Read it, fork it, own it.
styles.usage: Everything that is read, ≤ 350px wide inside cards and 550px in a section.

styles.name: body-sm
styles.usage: Rows of links and files, a log row's problem line.

styles.name: control
styles.usage: Buttons, link-buttons and the header's links. The arrow beside it is set at 17px.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Captions, dates (with `tabular-nums`), swatch notes, the footer line. In `text-muted`.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Uppercase (the class adds it), ≤ 4 words, one per section, above its title, in `text-muted`. Geist, never a mono face; never numbered.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Glyph to label; the arrow's nudge on hover is half of this.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Inside chips; the grid gutter between tiles below 760px (the concept's 9).

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Label to the line under it; the arrow's distance from a button's label.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: The gutter between tiles and panels. The editorial grid is always flush at this step.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Page gutter below 760px.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Padding of a tile, a card and a post card.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Label to headline in a section's title column (the concept's 35).

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Between the title column and the content when a section stacks.

tokens.name: space-9
tokens.usage: Page gutter ceiling (`clamp(20px, 5vw, 72px)`); section padding below 760px (the concept's 78).

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Section side padding and column gap ceiling (`clamp(30px, 8vw, 140px)`).

tokens.name: space-11
tokens.usage: Section top and bottom padding ceiling (`clamp(90px, 12vw, 170px)`).

tokens.name: radius-0
tokens.usage: Every surface: sections, tiles, swatches, cards, the post card. Square is the default; the roundness of the brand lives in the loop.

tokens.name: radius-control
tokens.usage: Buttons, chips, key hints and the header's find button: rectangular, barely softened. Never a pill.

tokens.name: radius-window
tokens.usage: The frame around a capture of real work, and nothing else.

tokens.name: radius-icon
tokens.usage: The app icon tile (30 on 128, as in the master). Only on icons.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: The status dot and ring. The only other round things on a page are the loop and its dot.

size.note: Fixed sizes the concept states; everything else scales.

tokens.name: size-target
tokens.usage: Minimum height and width of anything that can be pressed.

tokens.name: size-header
tokens.usage: Header height; 72px below 760px.

tokens.name: size-wordmark-min
tokens.usage: Smallest width of the wordmark — and its width in the header and the footer.

tokens.name: size-mark-min
tokens.usage: Smallest size of the mark. Below it use the favicon files, tested separately at 16px.

tokens.name: size-measure
tokens.usage: Widest a lead runs; body copy in a section stops at 550px.

duration.note: How long things move. One scale: nothing outside it, and no single move longer than duration-story except a demo's run. With prefers-reduced-motion: reduce every duration is 0 and nothing waits hidden to enter.

tokens.name: duration-instant
tokens.usage: A control answering a finger: press (1 px down), select (a chip or the active row inverting).

tokens.name: duration-quick
tokens.usage: Hover (the arrow's 2 px) and every exit — leaving is about half as long as arriving, on ease-in.

tokens.name: duration-base
tokens.usage: UI arriving: a row, a message, a caption, the header stepping aside, the dot landing, the underline's wipe.

tokens.name: duration-slow
tokens.usage: Big things arriving: a line of display type rising, a capture, a stage, the route's line, the loop's arc.

tokens.name: duration-story
tokens.usage: The longest single move: the blue field growing out of the capture. A whole sequence (the hero's open, a view transition) fits inside it.

tokens.name: duration-stagger
tokens.usage: Between siblings: rows, chips, messages, the meta of a showcase. Lines of display type use 1.5× (90 ms). After six, the rest arrive together.

easing.note: Five curves, each with one job. Nothing in the system uses ease, ease-in-out or a spring from a library.

tokens.name: ease-out
tokens.usage: The house curve, the concept's own: a quick start and a long, calm landing. Everything that arrives or answers.

tokens.name: ease-in-out
tokens.usage: Things that travel from one place to another: the route's line, the loop's arc drawing, the blue field growing, a view transition.

tokens.name: ease-settle
tokens.usage: Only the dot: a small overshoot, then it lands — the period of an outcome, the mark's dot, the live status dot. The one thing in allok that bounces.

tokens.name: ease-in
tokens.usage: Exits: leaving fast, never lingering. Always with duration-quick.

tokens.name: ease-linear
tokens.usage: Time itself: counters, a waveform, progress, anything tied to the scroll.

travel.note: How far things travel when they arrive. Always up (they come from below) or from their own edge; never sideways, never from off-screen.

tokens.name: travel-1
tokens.usage: Small UI: a message, a log row, a principle, a demo step.

tokens.name: travel-2
tokens.usage: Text and captions fading up into place.

tokens.name: travel-3
tokens.usage: Captures and the post's capture rising, together with a scale from 96 %.
